discovery_run.supplemental_searches: Follow-up searches were used to check exact dates and distinguish strikes, protests, campaign rallies, elections, and historical lookalikes. The initial exploratory calls did not expose per-query UTC timestamps; the six primary queries above were rerun and timestamped. No source access barrier was bypassed.

candidate_events.event_date_confidence: low; inferred from same-day article timestamp
uncertainties: Single report; small or exact group size unknown; Alpha News labels the item Opinion.

candidate_events.event_type_signal: large annual march with explicit protest elements
candidate_events.issue: Genocide denial, Armenia-Turkey/Azerbaijan tensions, and post-2023 Nagorno-Karabakh grievances
uncertainties: Commemoration and protest overlap; protocol/category rules may exclude a primarily ritual annual procession. Diaspora events in London, Paris, and Los Angeles are outside the country scope and excluded.

candidate_events.event_type_signal: opposition/rights protest during European Political Community summit
issues: opposition allegations of attacks on the Armenian Apostolic Church
uncertainties: Sources do not provide a robust participant count. The event was announced by opposition actors and independently described as staged; claims about motivation/demands are attributed to organizers and participants.

candidate_events.event_date_confidence: medium for May, low for exact day
candidate_events.reported_participants: Dozens in confrontation video; total number of striking workers not consistently specified in opened reports
uncertainties: Exact start and end dates are not given; Azatutyun says protest ended with one worker detained, while EVN Report describes nine arrests in the video confrontation. Treat arrest counts as potentially different timepoints or reports, not reconciled.

candidate_events.location: Outside the Central Electoral Commission, Yerevan, Armenia
candidate_events.issue: Demand to annul June 7 parliamentary election results and hold a new election
candidate_events.reported_participants: Hundreds according to Kyiv Independent; Interfax calls it massive
uncertainties: Election results and related protest claims were politically contested. Sources vary in participant count wording; no exact crowd count found.

screened_non_candidates.event: Strong Armenia final campaign rally in Yerevan
screened_non_candidates.reason: Reported as a campaign rally without a distinct protest demand; retained as a screening note, not a protest candidate.
An election is not itself a protest event; election-result protest is separately recorded for June 14.
Search results included old 2024, 2022, and 2018 demonstrations; excluded as outside quarter/year scope.

search_and_source_failures.failure: Managed open returned HTTP 520 (Unknown Status Code).
search_and_source_failures.handling: Logged; no retry or access restriction bypass attempted. Other accessible reports were used for the June 14 protest.

coverage_limits: This is bounded public discovery, not proof of a complete event census or of absence in any month.
Election, opposition, church-related rhetoric, labor action, and local civic grievances were included in search coverage.
No June labor/church protest candidate was established by this bounded search; the one found Ijevan labor action is in May.
Election rallies and ceremonial marches are kept separate or flagged where protest classification is uncertain.
No diaspora-located event is attributed to Armenia.
